title: Hearing on screen time and devices in NYC public schools
summary: The Council's Oversight and Education Committees will examine how the Department of Education uses digital devices, screens and AI tools in city schools, including new 2026-27 screen time caps and a one-year moratorium on student-facing generative AI for grades 2K-8. The hearing will also review DOE's technology procurement practices, past device purchases such as the $320 million Chromebook contract, and compliance with the state's new 'Distraction-Free Schools' cellphone ban. Witnesses will include DOE officials, tech industry and advocacy groups, unions, parents, students and educators.
